# Transformer From Scratch

> A reverse-mode automatic differentiation engine and a decoder-only transformer language model, built from scratch, with every gradient verified against finite differences.

Languages: Python. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/transformer-from-scratch

## Source

- [src/transformer_from_scratch/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/transformer-from-scratch/blob/main/src/transformer_from_scratch/__init__.py): Transformer From Scratch - an autodiff engine and a transformer language model.
- [src/transformer_from_scratch/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/transformer-from-scratch/blob/main/src/transformer_from_scratch/cli.py): Command line interface for the transformer.
- [src/transformer_from_scratch/data.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/transformer-from-scratch/blob/main/src/transformer_from_scratch/data.py): The induction (copy) task: data the model can only solve by attending back.
- [src/transformer_from_scratch/evaluation.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/transformer-from-scratch/blob/main/src/transformer_from_scratch/evaluation.py): Evaluation: next-token accuracy, copy-region accuracy, perplexity, baseline.
- [src/transformer_from_scratch/inspect.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/transformer-from-scratch/blob/main/src/transformer_from_scratch/inspect.py): Inspecting what the trained model attends to.
- [src/transformer_from_scratch/model.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/transformer-from-scratch/blob/main/src/transformer_from_scratch/model.py): A decoder-only transformer language model built on the autodiff engine.
- [src/transformer_from_scratch/observability.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/transformer-from-scratch/blob/main/src/transformer_from_scratch/observability.py): In-process request metrics for the HTTP service (Prometheus text exposition).
- [src/transformer_from_scratch/research.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/transformer-from-scratch/blob/main/src/transformer_from_scratch/research.py): A causal study of how the copy task is solved, and what architecture it needs.
- [src/transformer_from_scratch/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/transformer-from-scratch/blob/main/src/transformer_from_scratch/service.py): A standard-library HTTP service exposing the trained transformer.
- [src/transformer_from_scratch/tensor.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/transformer-from-scratch/blob/main/src/transformer_from_scratch/tensor.py): A small reverse-mode automatic differentiation engine over dense matrices.
- [src/transformer_from_scratch/text.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/transformer-from-scratch/blob/main/src/transformer_from_scratch/text.py): Character-level language modeling on real English text.
- [src/transformer_from_scratch/training.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/transformer-from-scratch/blob/main/src/transformer_from_scratch/training.py): Training the transformer with an Adam optimizer written from scratch.
